prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic high-fashion editorial portrait of one original approved adult woman seated on the floor of a minimalist art-gallery corridor.
prompt.main_subject: Original approved adult woman with shoulder-length wavy brunette hair, natural makeup, calm direct gaze and realistic skin texture. She wears the supplied taupe satin slip top with spaghetti straps, oversized cream shearling or faux-fur coat draped around her shoulders, minimalist silver earrings and black strappy ankle-tie heels.
composition_elements: Subject sits on the polished floor leaning slightly against a beige wall, knees bent and hands resting on the floor and leg.
Gallery hallway with framed artworks, beige walls and polished stone flooring softened by depth of field.
Preserve satin sheen, coat texture, ankle ties, pose, gallery perspective and warm neutral palette.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm ambient gallery light with a soft directional key, gentle wall shadows, realistic coat texture and cinematic depth.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 2:3 portrait, 50mm lens at f/2, shallow depth of field, 8K detail, realistic skin, satin, shearling, stone and artwork texture, subtle 35mm grain, no text or watermark.
